signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage. 2 reviews say limits were reduced.

evidence.quote: Each document you send counts once, however many people sign it.
The count resets on the first of every calendar month.
At first tier 1 was free, now it isn’t and yet my tier 1 has the old limits
which then put me over the monthly limit.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 10 reviews (5.8% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: Customer service was useless and extremely delayed.
I tried my best to get support on the issue but no one responds.
I emailed support but havent heard back.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 2.8/5 vs 3.68/5 all-time (-0.88). 24% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $19 tier lacks 3 of 4 features in the $49 tier and includes a zero allowance.

evidence.quote: Individual Plan ($19): 20 Documents per month:; 0 Team members; Reduced BreezeDoc branding

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 2.8 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $19 vs a stated $180 regular price (89% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change the service.

trials.claim: A document counts as one document regardless of changes or addendums
trials.claimQuote: A document is considered one document, regardless of changes or addendums.
trials.reasoning: Neither exhibit mentions changes or addendums; counting per send and monthly resets do not show whether a changed document counts again.

exhibits.quote: Each document you send counts once, however many people sign it.
exhibits.argument: Counting is per send, so resending after changes or addendums counts again rather than remaining one document.

exhibits.quote: The count resets on the first of every calendar month.
exhibits.argument: Documents are subject to monthly quotas and resets, undermining a single permanent document count.

trials.claim: BreezeDoc is a document-signing solution for collecting signatures on contracts and agreements
trials.claimQuote: BreezeDoc is a document-signing solution that makes it easy for you to collect signatures on contracts and agreements.
trials.reasoning: The vendor and its terms describe BreezeDoc as an e-signature tool for getting contracts and agreements signed, and the reviews report delivery problems rather than showing it is not such a tool.

exhibits.quote: A key function of the software - sending document via email - is unreliable at best. I sent 20 contracts yesterday, and none of them were actually delivered to their recipients.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports contracts for signing were never delivered, contradicting that it collects signatures on contracts.

exhibits.quote: I tried to use this app twice and each time the signature boxes and date boxes did not appear on the document.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports signature boxes missing entirely, so signing workflow does not function as claimed.

exhibits.quote: BreezeDoc is designed for freelancers, agencies, and small businesses who want a streamlined, affordable solution for getting their agreements and contracts signed.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes BreezeDoc as a solution for getting agreements and contracts signed.

exhibits.quote: BreezeDoc is an e-signature tool that allows consultants, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and more to create, edit, and send e-signature documents to their prospects and clients.
exhibits.argument: Terms define BreezeDoc as an e-signature tool for creating and sending documents to prospects and clients.

trials.claim: Users can upload contracts and agreements with one click to be ready for signing
trials.claimQuote: With just one click, you can upload your contracts and agreements to BreezeDoc’s simple interface so they’re ready to be signed.
trials.reasoning: One buyer reports a slow, pre-built upload workflow while another reports uploading and sending quickly, so the exhibits conflict on the claimed one-click readiness.

exhibits.quote: the fact that I need to pre-build the document on google, and that i needs spaces instead of just inserting the flieds, made me spend 15 minutes in breezydoc and then decide to pay for pandadoc.... is just bad...
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports upload requires pre-building with spaces and takes 15 minutes, not one-click ready.

exhibits.quote: Upload a PDF, a Word file (.doc or .docx), an Excel sheet or an image up to 5 MB, or pick a file from Google Drive.
exhibits.argument: Uploads are limited by file type and 5 MB size plus conversion, undermining one-click ready for any contract.

exhibits.quote: Upload your own documents, or use our templates to get started fast.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users can upload their own documents to get started fast.

exhibits.quote: Purchased the product, opened it, uploaded a test doc, went right to actual document and sent to my client within 30 min.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms uploading a document and sending it to a client quickly works.

trials.claim: Users can mark signature, initials, and date box locations for prospects to complete
trials.claimQuote: Mark where you want signatures, initials, date boxes, and more on the contract, making it easy for prospects to complete the required info.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report initials being converted into full signatures and date fields being pre-filled with today's date, materially limiting the claimed signature, initials, and date-box marking.

exhibits.quote: However, when you click to add initials and then proceed to sign, the software changes all the initials into the full signature.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports initials and signature fields cannot stay separate, contradicting marking locations for prospects.

exhibits.quote: In fact, all the date fields, including the client’s signature date, were pre-filled with today’s date.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports date boxes are auto-filled with today and cannot be set correctly for signers.

exhibits.quote: Drag and drop signature fields, text fields, dates, and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users can drag and drop signature fields, text fields and dates.

exhibits.quote: I uploaded a PDF and created a template with the fields I need.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms creating a template with needed fields after uploading a PDF works.
